meta.title: Pipe Atlas
meta.description: Analyze Ascend NPU execution pipelines in the left sidebar: multi-task, multi-core timelines, scheduling and instruction-fetch stages, overlap detection and SVG/PNG export.

heading.title: Network timeline

import.title: Import a trace
import.description: Pipe Atlas JSON and Chrome Trace Event JSON are both accepted. Parsing stays in this browser; files up to 30 MB.
import.drop: Drop a JSON file here, or choose one
import.tooLarge: This file is larger than 30 MB. Filter cores or a time window upstream first.
import.empty: Paste JSON or choose a file first.
help.title: Working with the timeline
help.body: Keyboard shortcuts work after the timeline has focus. Selecting an event always shows its direct dependencies; the dependency toggle expands every relation.
help.keys.key: W / S · A / D · F · / · Esc
help.data: Data contract: devices → cores → lanes, tasks and kernels, scenarios with events. Parsing stays upstream; this panel only validates and renders.
footer.left: Structure the data first; then visualize execution.
